ownership: United States federal government public aggregate data
prohibited_use: attempting to identify individual employers from protected aggregates
representing annual aggregate counts as a current named-business directory
converting suppressed or unpublished values to zero
attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau ZIP Business Patterns.
retention: Indefinite for public aggregate source releases and derived artifacts unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Allowed with source, reference year, disclosure limitations, transformation version, and provenance.
